name: Peterson Company
old_description: Welcome to Peterson Company’s Steel Division – your trusted partner for exceptional steel solutions in Utah & Colorado! With a rich legacy of delivering top-quality steel products, we provide a comprehensive range of steel materials for construction, manufacturing, and more! Our commitment to precision, durability, and customer satisfaction sets us apart. From structural steel to custom fabrication, we’re here to meet your steel needs with excellence and expertise.
about:
Peterson Company, doing business as Peterson Co, is headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah, and serves the Rocky Mountain region including Utah and Colorado. The company operates two divisions: a steel fabrication division and an electrical manufacturers' representative division. No founding year or ownership details are disclosed in public sources.

The steel division supplies a range of steel products including structural steel, custom fabricated components, perforated sheet metal, and steel panels. These products are aimed at construction and manufacturing applications. The electrical division represents manufacturers of electrical equipment. The company does not publish facility square footage, employee count, or annual production volumes.

The company's customer base spans construction contractors and manufacturing operations throughout Utah and Colorado. It also lists steel industry resources among its served sectors.

According to its own description, Peterson Company differentiates itself through a commitment to precision, durability, and customer satisfaction.
